description: Validate HTML, CSS, JSON or XML you just wrote, or check HTML for accessibility (WCAG). Use after generating or editing markup. No key needed. The code is sent to validatehtml.com and not stored. status is 'failed' only on errors, which are spec violations. Warnings are best practices on valid code: mention them, do not treat them as failures.

code.description: The code itself, up to 1 MB. A fragment is accepted.

name: validate_code
